ambiguities: Games with season>=2009 but no pbp (2009 season) get NaN raw values; they still occupy a slot in the EWMA series (NaN, shifted) and contribute 0 to S cumulative sums.
Team-level 'usable pbp' for 0-vs-NaN counts is determined at game level (game has any pbp row after deletions).

Quarter points: first play of qtr q with non-null total_home_score AND total_away_score; q5 start = first play with qtr==5 (any OT period start), else final score; if quarter q+1 missing (not in pbp) points NaN.
Drives defined from plays with non-null fixed_drive and posteam; drive attributes from first row by play_id; drive_quarter_start NaN drives excluded from regulation set.
Fixed_drive_result NaN -> other. 'Opp touchdown' and 'Turnover' -> to.
kr_tb/kk_tb: touchback NaN treated as 0 over all kickoff_attempt==1 plays with relevant team non-null; kr_td share of received kickoffs with return_touchdown==1.
kr_start: bare '50' -> 50; unparseable yard line -> NaN and skipped in the mean; drive_start_transition matched upper-case 'KICKOFF' exactly (OWN_KICKOFF, ONSIDE_KICK excluded).
td_n counts all touchdown==1 plays with non-null td_team (including defensive TDs credited to td_team) regardless of posteam.
Late-game occasions: rows with null score_differential or game_seconds_remaining excluded; late_n=0 -> raw contributes 0/0 and cumulative sums unaffected.
S league ratio L uses all team-games dated strictly before the game date (both teams counted), NaN if league denominator 0.
EWMA shift applies to full chronological team series within the universe (season>=2009 completed games); ordering by (gameday, game_id) as strings/dates.
Defence o3_def_* = opponent's raw o3 in same game, then EWMA over team's own series; NaN if opponent raw NaN.
Team-normalisation applied to posteam, defteam, td_team, games teams and yard-line team token.
Stats on 'Opp touchdown'-class drives and plays with deleted/aborted removed prior to drive formation.
